disclaimer: issuer_signature_valid, native_evidence_valid and protocol_valid are corpus-supplied experimental flags; neither implementation performs any cryptographic verification.
independence_note: the relational oracle re-derives verdicts from the raw case objects in expanded-cases.json, not from the Python evaluator's verdict stream; case expansion (build_case plus mutations) and the expected labels are shared with the Python entry point, so agreement is implementation diversity over verdict derivation, not independent validation of the labels.
